import html from typing import List # Example template – adjust placeholders to match your actual format. FORUM_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
    {points}
""" def build_forum_entry( post_title: str, post_body: str, bullet_points: List[str], ) -> str: """ Build a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- post_title : str The title or main topic of the forum post. post_body : str The main body or content of the forum post. bullet_points : list[str] A collection of user-provided discussion points or options in markdown format. Returns ------- str A string containing the fully formatted and sanitized HTML representation of the forum post. """ # Sanitize title and body to prevent XSS attacks safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Convert markdown bullet points to HTML list items safe_points = [] for point in bullet_points: # Escape the markdown content first escaped_point = html.escape(point, quote=True) safe_points.append(f"
  • {escaped_point}
    • ") # Join list items into a single string points_html = "".join(safe_points) # Format the final HTML using the template return FORUM_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, body=safe_body, points=points_html )
